intro: Archery is Bhutan's national sport, played with loud cheering and dancing.

chapters.title: Archery
text: Archers shoot at small targets 145 m away, while teammates sing and dance to put off opponents.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Football is popular, and Bhutan has sent archers to the Olympics since 1984.

items.title: Bhutan Premier League
items.subtitle: Football
items.text: Paro FC are a top club.

places.title: Famous venues
places.intro: Where Bhutan's biggest sporting moments happen.

items.title: Olympic debut
items.text: Bhutan sends archers to Los Angeles.
